dedupe_keys.name: database of tailings deposits and multidimensional poverty in chile

description: This exploratory database links the number of mine tailings deposits in each Chilean municipality with the municipality's average multidimensional poverty. It was assembled by Iván Ojeda-Pereira, Fernando Campos-Medina and Hernán Pezóa to study the social distribution of mining waste in Chile and is linked to a 2023 article (doi:10.1080/17445647.2023.2217514). The record, dated 2 September 2022, holds one Excel file of about 0.1 MB and is a free Zenodo download under CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: it is a municipal-level table with counts, not a geographic inventory of the deposits, the poverty measure is an average for each municipality, and the record does not say which year of the Chilean tailings register was used. For simulation it adds social vulnerability and equity indicators to hazard exposure studies of tailings facilities, for example to weigh the consequences of a dam failure on poorer municipalities. Related catalogue records include the Global Tailings Portal and the WISE Uranium chronology of tailings dam failures.
